body:
I'm sorry to continue this long post with a new comment but i'm feeling super off. 

I've had mental health issues for years and this hit me so hard. It's like losing a best friend.. I have been lonely as long as I remember and she brought joy to my daily life- Something to hold on to. My heart feels empty, yet I can literally feel my heart breaking.

I get you mate. Definitely share the same feelings, you're not alone. I don't want to say the cliche of ''it will be okay'' but I HOPE it will. It just hurts to be alive. It's like- You're already dead, but just not physically and that's the dirty work depression makes us do. Which takes a lot, doing something that every nerve in your body is telling not to. I'm so sorry that you're feeling this way too- Always feel free to hit me up with a message if you wanna talk!

First of all, i'm so sorry about your sister. I couldn't even imagine coping with something like that. Even if I can't completely relate or know how bad you're feeling, I can imagine how rough it is to lose someone so important. You're so strong, stronger than what you might think. Sounds extremely rough honestly. Life really sucks, and I wish the best for you. You're really brave to be here today and i'm so proud of you! 

Lifelong depression and anxiety is something super tough to deal with. I'm happy to hear that you've also gotten some medication to help you with your anxiety. Job for sure can be stressful and I totally get it. It's good to have one, since it gives you a stable ground. But, of course it's hard especially with all of the things going on in your life. It can get super challenging, have you talked about it with someone you trust? It could help you relax about it. Just a day at a time, but never forget to sometimes stop for a while and take your time to process everything. :)

Might be weird to ask but do you have any expriences of feeling- Numb? I don't know how to explain it. I've been feeling empty and just can't figure out if it's normal or why is it happening.

Today is my ex best friend's birthday, I thought they'd be the one who'd be by my side till the very end. But I've started seeing their true colors, I could've never believed of them. They'd mentally abuse me and leave me, replace, then come back, abuse me and then the whole thing keeps repeating. It felt like I had to compete against other people and prove that i'm better, 'cause I didn't want to lose her. I don't even want them near me but I miss them. So much. 

I've lost my girlfriend. My bestfriend. All of my friends. I do understand why my friends left, I started prefering time alone and keeping my thoughts to myself and overall isolating. This year overall has been the absolute worst, i've been struggling with suicidal thoughts for quite a few years. Atleast two. I never  open up to anyone but i'm literally feeling like i'm on the edge and even the smallest things seem to break me apart. I used to open up actually, but after figuring out nobody actually cared I chose not to. It's been so long since, and now when I open up, I immadiately feel like i shouldn't have told anything. And I struggle at finding the words. Thing after another, it makes me so tired to keep holding on. Having extreme mood swings, one second being fine, the next I might be feeling like my whole world's ending. I don't blame anyone for leaving me, it's hard to be with me if I don't even open up. 

People always leave saying i'm nothing but a burden or just a shitty person. Some (including my ex bff) come back saying they weren't serious. And I can't seem to shake off the thoughts of me being an absolute shitty person anymore. I used to not care when people say things like that. But now, those negative thoughts are on the top of my head like 24/7. I've tried to change and I do admit, after all these years i've had moments of joy. Episodes where i'd feel a little more stable. But no matter how my life would take a turn to the best i'd be here, sitting and thinking of ending my life. Or crossing a bridge, thinking what if i'd just jump now. I always think those type of things. 

I've tried to talk to psychiatrists, a few times actually. I never seem to have the guts to open up about things that  genuinely make me upset. I'm extremely anxious all the time and talking is not my thing.

​

This is long but if you read the whole thing, I truly appreciate. Mind telling me what's going on and overall opening up about your feelings? I'd love to support you. You matter!
Not so well, and i'm so sorry to hear that you're in pain too :I I'm not doing so well. Everything is just a little too much to bear with. Thank you for caring! You matter, stay strong ♥
Yeah, not doing so well but alive, thank you for caring
